title: A producer edits a shop that already exists

criteria.text: Owner edits image, name, about and a free-text values line from one prefilled page
criteria.note: [V] image, name, about: Edit page Basics card (EditCards.tsx, #472) through group.update (#158). Values half: a 'Values & badges · Coming soon' card with no field (#465); no values column. Conflict: values cut by DECISIONS 2026-09-07 and 2026-10-06, and the scenario's own approved line says 'values statement cut'; criterion text still names it

criteria.text: Only an active owner can save; the write goes through a named handler with an event row
criteria.note: [V] group.update (src/actions/group/update.ts): managing role with left_at null, active/archived only, appends group.updated naming the fields. Built in #158 (no Reviewed by line); deploy-health green on 1ebe680. unmarked: src/actions/group/update.test.ts ('refuses a stranger', 'writes an event naming the fields')

criteria.text: The values column has no source or provenance field; nothing but the owner's own edit can write it
criteria.note: [V] no values_statement column in supabase/migrations; tests/migrations-page-identity.test.ts asserts only that one migration does not add it. Same conflict as 1: the values line is cut, so the column this guards does not exist

criteria.text: A tagline of at most 120 characters, separate from the description, on card, profile and link preview
criteria.note: [V] no tagline column, no field in group.update or Edit, nothing in share-metadata. TileCard takes a tagline prop but OwnPages passes the description into it

criteria.text: A Page with every optional field empty renders correctly, with nothing nagging
criteria.note: [V] ShopPublicPage omits an empty description, placement heading and badge; Products shows 'Nothing posted yet' only when that component is on [A: not nagging]. Sections from #472 (Reviewed by), deploy-health green on 614c920. unmarked: ShopPublicPage.test.tsx ('omits it when empty', 'no empty heading, no placeholder')

criteria.text: On the draft or live Page, an address search resolves to real coordinates with a confirming pin before saving; an unresolvable address refuses loudly
criteria.note: [V] WhereFields + PinAdjustMap (#351, Reviewed by; deploy-health green on 3492589). 'Drop a pin' (#441) saves the map's coordinates, not a placeholder. With no map key the address is used as found and no map is drawn. unmarked: WhereFields.test.tsx ('says so when nothing matches the address'), PinAdjustMap.test.tsx

criteria.text: A neighbourhood or town from a seeded list covering MSA 40900; a neighbourhood-mode Page shows no street address anywhere and a pin at the centre
criteria.note: [V] seeded boundaries (#350: 88 places, 165 neighbourhoods in Sacramento and West Sacramento), pick in #351 and #468, saves a neighborhoodId and no point (where-save.ts). Page map draws a pin at the area centre (PageMap.tsx); Explore draws a disc per the 2026-10-07 ruling. No standing guard over every surface. unmarked: where-save.test.ts, tests/boundaries-db.test.ts

criteria.text: Owner picks or creates tags in their own words, editable any time; no category and no 'Something else'; at least one tag to publish
criteria.note: [V] group.update replaces the tag set and refuses none (#288, no Reviewed by; deploy-health green on a5ab3a1); group.activate refuses a Page with no tags. group.update still accepts a category but no Edit or Create component offers one. unmarked: update.test.ts ('refuses to leave a Page with no tags'), activate.test.ts, ShopPublicPage.test.tsx ('no category chip')

criteria.text: Optional public business phone, separate from the private phone, shown to signed-in visitors only
criteria.note: [V] groups.contact_phone granted to authenticated only; loadPageView reads contact only when signed in (#305, no Reviewed by; deploy-health green on 7381f60). unmarked: tests/page-contact-db.test.ts ('never answer a signed-out caller')
